name: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

evidence.summary: SASTIND and the Ministry of Education named HUST in 2016 as one of 16 universities they co-build for 2016–2020, to support defence-specialty disciplines and majors, defence key discipline laboratories and training for the defence industry.

CASI identifies the national defence science and technology key laboratory for multi-spectral information processing technology at HUST’s School of Artificial Intelligence and Automation, which researches multispectral image processing for guidance, navigation and target recognition.
items: Defense S&T Key Laboratory of Multi-Spectral Information Processing Technology (多谱图像信息处理技术国防科技重点实验室)

evidence.summary: HUST runs a joint doctoral programme with the PLA Naval University of Engineering.
